opening.argument: The presentation promotes participation in mining robots through a stated investment of “$ 500 per 1000 days” and identifies the underlying account as “My mining account.” It then attributes extraordinary performance to the robot, claiming it “has produced about 88.2% daily in dollars,” while connecting reinvestment and compound growth to a projected outcome of around seven Bitcoins. Viewers are invited to obtain club information and become members. Although the speaker may acknowledge an error in the calculations, the material presents paid participation and highly ambitious daily returns without establishing that the figures are accurate or attainable.

citations.quote: this robot has produced about 88.2% daily in dollars
